top_goals.name: 全イベント完全解析

top_goals.evidence: ROM-wide structural framing now anchors 816 B0-start records across 107 families. Crosslinking only source-reader-validated A4 selections maps 1,124 callsites into 713 records across 98 families. This materially advances event inventory and script-to-resource linkage, while conditions/actions/runtime completeness remain incomplete. Controller-pointer dispatch is now linked end-to-end for family 0x4E: opcode 09 -> opcode 59 -> controller SoA pointer -> 84:867D/8699 keyed matcher -> CC:1B42 A4 17. This strengthens effect linkage but does not yet increase complete-event inventory. Event-trigger regions are now machine-readable across the hotspot corpus (57 regions), separating VM point/rectangle predicates from native-boundary regions while retaining transition/destination provenance. 2026-10-03 bounds-disambiguation raises trigger-region destination-config coverage from 52/57 to 56/57 without coordinate-neighbor inference. 2026-10-03 parallel-map reconciliation adopts the newer committed map-transition floor of 1,295 candidates / 1,063 destination-config resolutions / 793 arrival-coordinate resolutions / 211 destination packs and reduces the active trigger crosslink frontier to 11 explicitly classified rows. 2026-10-03 CC:0F71 arrival provenance is closed by an independent opcode-0x57 route witness for the same pack 0xBC entry 0x02, reducing trigger crosslink backlog 11->10.

top_goals.name: 別環境で再構築可能な完全仕様書

top_goals.evidence: FastROM HiROM addressing, overlapping source-family model, script-pack/source-family crosswalk and deterministic usage catalog are portable and reproducible. Full subsystem coverage and independent verification remain incomplete. Event-record framing and event-to-source linkage are now reproducibly externalized as tools plus metadata summaries. Event-trigger provenance gaps are now machine-readable rather than a generic unresolved bucket. A reproducible bounds-based destination-config overlay now converts committed transition XY plus native bounds into unique config provenance where exactly one candidate survives.
